name: Do I need architectural plans or permits for a multi-room remodel in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Do I need architectural plans or permits for a multi-room remodel in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for most multi-room remodels in cities like Berkeley, Oakland, or Albany, architectural plans and permits are typically required, especially if the project involves structural changes, significant layout modifications, plumbing or electrical alterations, or additions to your home's footprint. These requirements ensure your project complies with local building codes and safety standards. Frasheski Construction assists clients throughout the entire permitting process, preparing necessary documentation and coordinating with local authorities to ensure a smooth approval process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, most multi-room remodels in Berkeley or Oakland require architectural plans and permits for structural, layout, or system changes. We manage this process.
